The '''Arzid system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its primary was the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tiki-hava]], whose gigantic green [[fire storm]]s posed a navigational hazard in the system and cast a green space-glow for thousands of miles. The system was the location of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arzid]].<ref name="PDS" />
